IndicatorInfo.interacaoAvaliativaInfo: Considers students' interactions in graded course forums.
IndicatorInfo.interacaoNaoAvaliativaInfo: Considers students' voluntary interactions in non-graded course forums.
IndicatorInfo.desempenhoInfo: Considers students' final grade in the course.
IndicatorInfo.profCogInfo: Considers students' cognitive engagement across the course tasks.
IndicatorInfo.relacaoAlunoProfInfo: Considers direct communication between students and teachers through forums.
IndicatorInfo.desistenciaInfo: Indicates students with low overall classifications across the other indicators, commonly associated with course dropout.
IndicatorInfo.feedbackInfo: Assesses the quality and frequency of feedback provided by the tutor in graded activities, considering corrections made, feedback presence, and the type of response offered to students (textual and/or PDF annotations).
IndicatorInfo.accessInfo: Analyzes the tutor's presence and regularity of access to the platform, based on log records, indicating the level of course monitoring.
IndicatorInfo.responseInfo: Assesses the tutor's forum participation, considering response volume and average response time to student messages, classified as: fast (less than 1 day), normal (between 1 and 5 days), delayed (more than 5 days), or no response.
